court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Swati Raosaheb More (Swati Sunny ... vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr.

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mrs. Swati Raosaheb More, Student, and others
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra and Mrs. Shailaja Suresh Dimber

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioners seek to quash a criminal case registered with the Dattawadi Police Station for offences punishable under various IPC sections. The petition was referred for mediation, which was unsuccessful, and then admitted by this Court.

legal_principles.principle: Making a demand for alimony cannot be equated to an offence of extortion punishable under section 384 of the Indian Penal Code.
legal_principles.held: None of the ingredients as required to invoke the offences as alleged are available and/or made out.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging an offence to prove all the ingredients of that offence.
legal_principles.held: None of the ingredients as required to invoke the offences as alleged are available and/or made out.

legal_principles.principle: A person's marital status can only be shown as 'unmarried' if they are neither a widow nor a divorcee and no decree of divorce is in existence.
legal_principles.held: The Petitioner No.1 could have only selected the said option of unmarried as she was neither a widow nor a divorcee and no decree of divorce was in existence or in her position at the said time.

outcome.final_order: The present Criminal Writ Petition is allowed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
